text:
ashley: quick q — I need to pull a one-off audit dump for a vendor API key (abc123) from 2026-03-15. Who can run an ad-hoc export? Legal wants a redacted copy (mask emails + user_ids) and prefers parquet if possible. Low urgency but would like this by EOD if doable.

jordan: I can run the export once sec approves. We have the `audit_events_vw` view and a job that can write parquet to S3 under s3://redwood-audit/dumps/. FYI exports include full request_body by default (so we need to redact).

anika: FYI policy — PII (emails, user_ids) must be masked for ad-hoc exports unless legal requests raw with a subpoena. Retention for ad-hoc dumps: store only in secure share for 7 days then delete. For this case we should run the redaction pipeline that strips emails and hashes user_id.

ashley: what is the quick command / flow? can we generate ephemeral credentials so the operator doesn't need permanent S3 perms?

jordan: flow I normally use: file the security request, tag sec+legal, I run the job with a short-lived IAM role and push the final redacted artifact to the legal bucket. Quick psql snippet (run on analytics instance):
```sql
-- find events for key abc123 on 2026-03-15
SELECT id, event_ts, actor_email, action, request_body
FROM audit_events_vw
WHERE api_key = 'abc123'
  AND event_ts >= '2026-03-15'
  AND event_ts < '2026-03-16';
```
Then `COPY` the results, pipe to our redactor tool, or write parquet via the internal parquet_writer that runs with the exporter role.

anika: please include these in the security request: justification, who will receive the file, retention (7d), and whether legal needs raw. I'll approve if it's redacted and only going to legal. If it's for compliance/subpoena, note that flow is different (sec will escalate).

ashley: filing ticket now — /security-requests #12345, @anika @jordan added. Also adding `legal@redwood.com` as receiver.

jordan: deploy-bot kicked off export job (ephemeral role) — job id 202603151230, starting extraction.

deploy-bot: export job 202603151230 started by jordan (ephemeral role) — queued -> running. ETA ~5m.

jordan: extraction complete, ran redactor with rules: mask(email), hash(user_id). Writing parquet and csv to a temp s3 prefix. Uploaded final artifact to s3://redwood-legal/exports/1765004321-redacted.zip and generated presigned link (7d). I limited ACL to legal + sec.

anika: redaction check: sampled 100 rows, no cleartext emails or user_ids found. I confirm policy compliance. Also logged approver & operator in the security ticket.

ashley: great — can you paste the presigned link in the ticket and mark the ticket with the deletion date?

jordan: link pasted in /security-requests/12345. Deletion scheduled: 7 days from now (2026-03-22). I also recorded who downloaded in the S3 access log.

anika: noted. If legal asks for raw, they need to open a subpoena channel and sec will handle stricter controls. For now closing on our side once legal confirms they retrieved it.

ashley: perfect, thanks @jordan and @anika :thumbsup:

jordan: np, ping me if legal needs any additional filters or columns.

anika: closing the loop — approval + export recorded in ticket 12345, retention and redaction documented.

(reacts: :eyes: from legal, :white_check_mark: from ashley)
